description: Bundled backup and verified-restore sidecar: restic to a firm-owned Backblaze B2 bucket with Object Lock, monthly restore drills with per-module decrypt canaries, printed Recovery Kit, and bare-metal recovery.
note: BK-0 scaffold. userFacing flips to true when the self-contained UI ships (BK-10) and the appliance console proxies it (BK-10a). Discovery of what to back up is by container label (vibe.backup.contract), not by this manifest — see build plan D-9 and section 4.2. Requires a Docker socket proxy restricted to list/inspect; wiring lands with BK-10a in Vibe-Appliance.
